name: manual_2e6c39
claim: Before pushing a Perpetua-Tools PR run scripts/review/repo_hygiene.py with --address-diff-base origin/main --address-diff-head HEAD and markdownlint-cli2 on every markdown file the diff touches. Added or moved lines must not contain loopback or private-range literals (use localhost). Touching a markdown file makes CI lint all of it, so revert a one-line edit to a heavily non-compliant doc and record the leftover instead of reflowing it.

decisions.notes: 2026-11-04: Perpetua-Tools CI failed a PR on checks the local commit hooks did not run: repo_hygiene over the commit range rejected added or moved lines containing loopback literals, and markdownlint-cli2 linted every markdown file the PR touched, so a one-line rename in a far-out-of-compliance doc failed 33 rules.
